title: Banished from the Hero’s Party
description: Banished From The Hero’s Party, I Decided To Live A Quiet Life In The CountrysideAfter being betrayed by the Hero’s party, Red hopes to start anew by opening an apothecary in a small town. He wants to keep his past life secret, but it won’t be easy…especially when a beautiful adventurer from his past asks to move in.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Red enjoys the slow life, gathering medicinal herbs and saving to open a shop. His life wasn't always so simple, but he's keeping that to himself. When a local boy falls ill, Red springs into action. Rit is intrigued when she hears of this, but why?

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Red hoped for the slow life but not slow business. Rit offers to help, but is it more than he wants? Red reflects on their history together and how Rit has changed. The Hero's party welcomes a new member and prepares for a new quest.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Red and Rit's partnership begins. Red explains how Blessings works to Tanta and his friend. Rit helps try to get Red's new concoction approved. Red tries a new product to boost sales. Some of the Heroes' party have second thoughts about Gideon leaving.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Red ponders his new life. Rit has a hankering for mead. Red gets an unfriendly visit. A sauna trip turns into a "heated" contest. Zeff's sauna business is in need of saving. Red finally learns what caused Rit's hankering. The Hero's party is on the rocks.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Rit has some important visitors who want her back in the guild, and they're not the only ones. Red gives Rit a gift, and she recalls the time she spent with him in the Hero's party. Rit has a run-in with Dir. Ruti recalls how she felt when Red left.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Red's visit with Dr. Newman becomes an emergency. Red and Rit have fun by the river. Will they take it to the next level? The Hero's Party seeks the former Demon Lord's weapon. Red reminisces about Ruti. A stormy night is suddenly interrupted.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Al is injured, but where are his parents? Ademi vanishes after accusations arise, and the people rise in protest. Red springs into action when Tanta is hauled in for questioning. The Hero's party's quest for the previous Demon Lord's weapon ends.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The double bed finally arrives. Rit tries to thwart a plot. Bighawk unveils his plan. When one of his own is in danger, Red comes to the rescue. Albert's quest for glory takes a dark turn. Al defuses an angry mob and heads off on his first adventure.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ruti and Tisse go on a quest for a certain medicine, but can they avoid attracting attention? Red and Rit try to drum up business. Red and Tisse unwittingly cross paths. Rit and Red aid a sick fay. Ruti finds what she's looking for and then some.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Ruti reunites with Gideon and tries to get him to rejoin her party. But seeing how happy he is, she has to make a tough choice. Tisse and Ruti have a communication breakdown. Bui hunts for something he needs. Ruti opens up about her emotions.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Tisse gets Red up to speed about Ruti's situation. Red and Danan catch up. Ares encounters Danan, too, but something doesn't add up. Red and company head for an ancient ruins to find Ruti, but a fateful showdown awaits when former comrades cross paths.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Red and company seek Ares in the ancient elven ruins. Ares tries to make Ruti return to her role as the Hero. Danan confronts and exposes Bui and Theodora makes a shocking move. Friendships are tested and comrades betrayed in a climactic battle.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Ruti learns what it means to be the Hero, and Theodora has a change of heart. Ruti enjoys the slow life. Red and company attend Ares' funeral and ponder the mystery of the holy swords. Red and Rit grow even closer, but is a complication on the horizon?

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Red heads for a mountain range called the Wall at the World's End with his lover Rit and sister Ruti. It was supposed to be an easy trip to get materials for an engagement ring to give to Rit, but...

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Red and Rit reunite with Yarandrala and she suggests they move to the Kiramin Kingdom. Yarandrala's persistence on the subject leaves them a bit confused. Afterward, everyone takes a dip in the hot spring at Tisse's recommendation.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Cardinal Ljubo takes an interest in Zoltan's airship. Meanwhile, Zoltan is celebrating the Solstice Festival and it is bustling with activity. Red and his friends are enjoying the festival, but they come across a fight between some young people.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: It's morning as usual. Ruti reconsiders her ordinary daily life that she had abandoned as a hero. That morning, Tisse seemed to be acting strangely. Ruti tries to ask her about the previous night, but...

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Danan, who's been undergoing medical treatment, is on the mend. Before leaving town, Danan asks to arrange a deal with Red. Red readily accepts and a special training camp with the former hero party commences.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Van and the others are headed to Zoltan. If Ruti's existence should come to light, there could be trouble, so Red and Rit decide they should take Ruti on a trip.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While Red and his companions are vacationing in St. Durant, they receive word of an ogre king that attacked the village. When Red and his friends go looking, the situation turns out to be more serious than expected.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Tisse, who accompanied Van on his quest to defeat the hill giant, is shocked by Van's twisted sense of justice. His justice is directed at the Zoltan people who welcome the hero, and a large-scale commotion develops.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: In order to drive Van away from Zoltan, Red and his friends aim to appease Ljubo and Lavender. Rit is the one who volunteers to negotiate with Lavender. The method she utilizes is... love stories?!

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Van and the others rush into Red's shop, accusing Esta of betrayal. Red, who encountered Van's values during their discussion, makes a bold move to make contact with him in an attempt to overturn his rigid thinking.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: At Tisse's request, Albert heads off to search for a girl who has disappeared in the forest. Although she is found to be safe, Van, who has also come to rescue her, takes issue with the creature that led her astray which culminates in a skirmish.

episodes_data.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Red, who dominates with his skill, and Van, who attacks with his tenacity, engage in a back-and-forth battle. Meanwhile, Lavender is furious at Van's predicament. A huge shadow flows from her body attacking Rit and the others.
